summary.en-US: YouTube videos pick up where you left off, even when you click a thumbnail after its preview.

description.en-US:
Ever hovered over a YouTube thumbnail, watched the preview for a bit, clicked it… and the video started over from the beginning? This add-on makes it keep playing from where the preview was. (Chrome already does this. Firefox doesn't.)

It also remembers videos you stopped halfway: open one again later, and it picks up right where you left off.

You can choose how long it remembers your videos: 15 days by default.

No account needed. Nothing leaves your computer.
